senses.gloss:
Veṇu in the Atharvaveda and later denotes a ‘reed’ of bamboo, It is described in the taittirīya Saṃhitā as ‘hollow’ (su-ṣira). In the Rigveda it occurs only in a vālakhilya hymn in a Dānastuti (‘praise of gifts’), where Roth thinks that ‘flutes of reed’ are meant, a sense which veṇu has in the later texts. The kauṣītaki brāhmaṇa couples veṇu with sasya, stating that they ripen in vasanta, ‘spring.’ Apparently bamboo reeds are meant.
